abilities.effect: The triggering creature falls in and continues to fall, potentially forever. That creature can try to Grab an Edge to avoid falling. The DC to Climb the walls or Grab an Edge is 26.
abilities.name: Infinite Pitfall
abilities.trigger: A creature walks onto the trapdoor

hazard.description: An iron trapdoor covers an infinitely deep 10-footsquare pit.
hazard.disable: DC 28 Thievery (trained) to remove the trapdoor
hazard.name: Bottomless Pit
hazard.reset: The trap still causes creatures to fall forever if they fall in, but the trapdoor must be reset manually for the trap to become hidden again.

stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.note: or 0 if the trapdoor is disabled or broken or *detect magic*

hazard.text: The pit contains many handholds, so the falling creature can try to Grab an Edge again every 6 seconds. If the creature succeeds, it can start to Climb out from that point (though it might be a very long climb, depending on how far the creature fell). Since the creature falls endlessly, it can rest and even prepare spells while falling, though items dropped while falling are usually lost forever.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

traits.name: Mechanical
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a constructed physical object.

traits.name: Trap
traits.text: A hazard constructed to hinder interlopers.
